recent.text: Lawson Crouse said the Mammoth need to demand more of themselves. That's exactly what needs to happen after the team lost another player to injury and Wednesday's game against the Golden Knights. #TusksUp https://t.co/xahrDEM0Ro
recent.author: Chase Beardsley

recent.text: POSTGAME "The effort was great. The boys worked really hard. But mentally, we need to be able to stay more even-keeled when adversity happens." @UtahMammoth André Tourigny on tonight's takeaways https://t.co/WLOlBZsoOj
recent.author: Utah Mammoth PR

recent.text: POSTGAME "Guys play hard, they go down. But we believe in everyone in our locker room, and it's that 'next guy up' mentality." @UtahMammoth Lawson Crouse on battling adversity as a group https://t.co/ySaCVn13Wz
recent.author: Utah Mammoth PR

recent.text: “(McBain) had a really, really good night. Same thing for (Crouse). I think they played with a lot of drive, a lot of passion. They (won) battles, they played really well.” -Head coach André Tourigny
recent.author: Catherine Bogart

recent.text: “We talk about adversity. These are the moments where we all need to rise up. Everyone in the locker room needs to demand more out of themselves, and that’s what we’re going to do.” -Associate Captain Lawson Crouse
recent.author: Catherine Bogart

recent.text: Lawson Crouse on what he needs to do as a leader to help the Mammoth end their losing skid: "Just playing our game and playing a full 60. We talk a lot about our pace, our speed, and how we want to play. We got to do that. Staying out of the box is going to be a big priority.
recent.author: Chase Beardsley

recent.text: “You love to see it from (McBain). He’s a guy that does everything right. True teammate and nice to see him get rewarded.” -Associate Captain Lawson Crouse on Jack McBain
recent.author: Catherine Bogart

recent.text: “We believe in everyone in our locker room, and it’s that next guy up mentality. We knew coming in it would be a difficult game, but we just got to learn from it, regroup, and get ready for tomorrow night.” -Associate Captain Lawson Crouse
recent.author: Catherine Bogart

recent.text: Tourigny on Sebastian Cossa’s performance: “I will need to look at the tape to analyze all the goals and all the scoring chances. I think he made great saves during the game. We'll have to look at all the goals and have a better read on it.” #TusksUp
recent.author: Chase Beardsley

recent.text: That's all for tonight. The injured Mammoth played well given the circumstances, but it wasn't enough to stave off their third consecutive loss. Final score: 5-3 VGK #TusksUp #VegasBorn
recent.author: Brogan Houston

recent.text: Final: Golden Knights: 5, Mammoth: 3. Tough one for the shorthanded Mammoth. They battled hard in the first and played ok in the third. A horrendous second put them in a hole they couldn't dig out of. Not a great game for the blueline and Cossa. #TusksUp
recent.author: Chase Beardsley

recent.text: Cossa to the bench. Extra attacker on for Utah. Took way longer than Utah wanted.
